answer: Continuous Micro-Work Ledger. Each identity must publish small, verifiable tasks (e.g., compute shards) before any payout; rewards unlock only after independent workers confirm results. Cloning N identities multiplies the unpaid work each must front, while honest agents amortize the same effort across real output. A zephyr of cheap fake tasks gets filtered by random audit sampling.
